I’m not entirely sure what you’re asking. Perhaps elaborate a bit.

If you’re asking to make it simpler, it’s not actually that complex. Just leave the config.json as is. And then in the loot.json increase the number on things you feel like you get too few of. Say to 2. And for things you find to many of, decrease it to say 0.5.

2 is double.

0.5 is half

comments.author: DeadLeaves
comments.body_html:
If they’re not specific, they’ll be adjusted by the category.

So an item will first check map specfic item, then global specfic item, then map specfic category, then global category

So ledx interchange first

and if that doesnt exist global ledx adjustments

and if that doesnt exist interchange eletronics

and if that doesnt exist global eletronics.

All the adjustments that are there by default are just what I like to run, (and balanced around my ReLooted mod.) You can add and remove categories and items anywhere, Just make sure to leave all global categories as a last fallback multiplier. If an item has no mutliplier it will complain in the server console.

So as for your question in the end, Yes you can copy that to any map. (though if there is no spawn point for said item, it wont make them magically appear) It only adjusts existing spawn points.

Okay I figured it out for everyone having this issue: Do NOT modify the base loot value of the map.

If you modify the total amount of loot then the map will attempt to spawn that amount, which means if it runs out of slots by the time it gets to keycard spawns it will ALWAYS fill those slots because its trying to reach that capacity.

comments.body_html: It will not create new spawn points, it works with what it there. However, there is also a total spawn limit on the maps. comments.author: Shturman
comments.body_html: I meant how can I make money or other items spawn more often since I have already set them to 100.0 and sometimes these items still don’t appear

comments.author: DeadLeaves
comments.body_html:
Due to the nature of how SPT has implemented loot, you can’t really set a single item to 100% spawn rate without breaking other spawns. Increasing the chance for one type (lets use money as an example), will make this mod increase the spawn points probability by a relative amount to the money’s spawn chance WITHIN that point. Say a point has 5 different items with the same weight, and a point chance of 10%.

Point: 10% — Money: 20w Bitcoin: 20w Chainlet: 20w Horse Statue: 20w Gold Chain: 20w If you then double the chance for money. Itll look like this

Point: 12% — Money: 40w Bitcoin: 20w Chainlet: 20w Horse Statue: 20w Gold Chain: 20w You’ve doubled the odds of money being selected, but the point only increased by 12 percentage units.

So if you MASSIVELY increase money, youll also increase the point, but you also basically make the other spawns never happen either. So I don’t recommend to go that hard with anything. AND you’ll also make OTHER spawn points less likely to happen as well, since there is a fixed amount of spawn points per raid. And making one MORE likely, will make all other points LESS likely.

comments.author: MechaPhantasm
comments.body_html:
So, this is a small issue that people just using the default config wont notice, but for anyone tweaking the config file, the “loot - noadjust.jsonc” and “loot - relooted.jsonc” example files don’t have the new flier and Hideout area container categories added. This will cause the fliers not to spawn in game. Luckily, it’s not hard to add them back yourself. Just crack open your loot config file and under the globalCategories section add these two lines:

“6759673c76e93d8eb20b2080”: { “multi”: 1.00 }, //Fliers
“63da6da4784a55176c018dba”: { “multi”: 1.00 } //Hideout Area Container ???
